narrative.overview: Sightline v5 is a calm Apple-style workbench built around one relationship: the agent works on the page, then stops when human judgment is required.
keyCharacteristics: Solid white Stride page and translucent fixed review rail.
Blue agent action, orange human turn, green verification.
Issues and Agent log share one rail.
Approval rises from the page as a bottom sheet.
Monospace is reserved for literal WebMCP evidence.

rules.name: State Color
rules.body: Blue acts, orange waits for the person, green proves.

rules.name: Evidence
rules.body: Machine-readable facts use mono; decisions use system sans.

dos: Do keep page and review rail visible together.
Do stop every mutation at Your call.
Do keep native WebMCP results at 14 issues / score 72.
donts: Don't restore the pink unversioned variant.
Don't restore the custom welcome interface.
Don't add a third permanent panel or fake chat.
